sample_unit: clinical questions (each in long-form and short-form, across 3 LLMs)

links.outcome: Readability of LLM-generated sexual health information versus recommended reading levels
links.effect: All three models produced content above recommended reading levels; PCA showed one dominant component explaining 76.7% of variance across readability indices.
links.quote: All models produced content that exceeded recommended reading levels.

links.outcome: Guideline adherence of LLM answers across long-form versus short-form prompt phrasing
links.effect: Shorter, less complex prompts elicited higher guideline adherence than more complex clinical prompts; adherence estimated marginal means were ChatGPT 0.769, Gemini 0.499, Perplexity 0.457.
links.quote: Shorter, less complex prompts elicited higher adherence than more complex, clinical prompts.

screen.reason: Evaluated the guideline adherence and readability of responses from three commercial LLMs across different prompt phrasing styles for patient sexual health questions.
